**Question.** Can the CUDA engine's batched decode reach the memory-bandwidth
ceiling, and which remaining BF16 families tolerate quantization?

| setup | |
| --- | --- |
| node | head (single booster), head + peer (pair) |
| kernel | 6.17.0-1031-nvidia-64k, 64 KiB |
| commit | 2701afb |
| fuel | nvidia/GLM-5.3-Flash-NVFP4 hub rev 423acf3758, 33 shards |
| env | ROCKET_FUEL_NVFP4_DIR, ROCKET_ATTENTION_YAML, ROCKET_PACKED_WEIGHTS, ROCKET_FP8_ATTN_DIR, ROCKET_FP4_SHARED_DIR |

## Batch parity

`ctest` batch-parity compares greedy tokens of M=1, M=8, M=32 stream runs
against each stream's own M=1 reference. It failed 14/40 at first fuel contact.

Two root causes, both fixed:

1. Conv-tap upload converted F32 bits as integers (`static_cast<float>(u32)`
   instead of a bit copy), poisoning every KDA conv weight on the hub fuel.
   q/k hid it behind the l2 norm; v reached 4e8 and the model degenerated to
   `arena` loops from token 0.
2. `dense_gemm` sent batch>1 through cuBLAS while batch=1 used the custom
   kernel. Different reduction order, so M=8 could never match M=1
   bit-for-bit. Replaced with `gemm_batched_kernel`: per-element order
   identical to the batch-1 kernel, weight row read once per block.

```bash
ctest --test-dir engines/glm5-moe-nvfp4-2b/build/tests
# 100% tests passed, 0 tests failed out of 9
```

A python layer-0 reference (`scripts/numerics/glm53-layer0-reference.py`),
written from the in-tree vLLM Glm5Next kernel, reproduced NIM-era RMS 0.0048
where the broken engine gave 0.118, which localized the conv bug in one step.

## Quantization families

| family | bytes/token before | recipe | relL2 | gate |
| --- | ---: | --- | ---: | --- |
| KDA qkv, 34 layers | 6.85 GB | fp8-row | 0.028 | token-identical, 64 tok, 2 prompts |
| KDA o_proj + 5 MLA projs, 11+34 layers | 5.28 GB | fp8-row | 0.026-0.029 | token-identical, 64 tok, 2 prompts |
| shared experts, 43 layers | 2.16 GB | NVFP4 | ~0.09 | token-identical, 48 tok, 2 prompts |
| MLA kv_b | 0.40 GB | bf16 (deferred) | - | needs fp8 inside mla_absorb_q/expand_v |
| router, gates, conv, norms, hc | 0.66 GB | bf16 (kept) | - | selection + recurrence sensitive |

KDA-Q NVFP4 stays rejected per the 2026-09-06 entry: 9.4 percent relL2
diverged at token 2. fp8-per-row at 2.8 percent relL2 and half the bytes of
BF16 passed the same prompts the fp4 screen failed.

```bash
python3 scripts/numerics/materialize-kda-qkv-fp8.py
ROCKET_FP8_ATTN_DIR=~/.cache/rocket-fuels/overlays \
  engines/glm5-moe-nvfp4-2b/build/rocket-decode \
  --prompt 'The capital of France is' --tokens 64
# token ids identical to the bf16 run, 12089 ' Paris' first on both
```

## Packed resident load

`scripts/fuels/pack-resident-weights.py` re-emits the loader's resident set
(1273 tensors, 16.02 GiB) as one safetensors file; `ROCKET_PACKED_WEIGHTS`
registers it as a preferred shard.

| load | time |
| --- | ---: |
| 33-shard cold | 10 to 30 s |
| packed | 4.7 s |

The first packer draft had the payload-relative offset bug on the read side
and copied shard header JSON as tensor bytes. A 12-tensor byte-exact sample
check against the source shards caught it; the check stays in the contract.

## Two-booster static fire

```bash
scripts/fabric/static-fire.sh --sweep 1,8 --expert-cache-gib 20
# STATIC FIRE PASS: 0/8 streams mismatched
```

Both ranks 144 experts, rank 1 loaded from its own fuel copy (rsync, 212 GiB
over the peer link at 600 to 850 MB/s). The launcher now forwards the fuel
and overlay env to the peer over ssh.

## Where the ceiling sits

Pattern ceiling 236 GB/s (scripts/hardware/mem-bw-sweep). Measured warm
single-booster min steps after all accepted families: c1 125 ms, c8 166 ms,
c16 255 ms, c32 467 ms. Full-NVFP4 bytes put the single-booster roofline at
about 69 agg tok/s at c8 and 77 at c16; the 20 tok/s/stream c8 target
(160 agg) needs the two-booster pair plus speculative decoding.

## Verdict

Accepted. Batch parity is a standing gate; the fp8-row recipe is the proven
default for attention families; NVFP4 is proven for MLP-shaped families.

**Next.**

- DFlash2 draft-verify loop (draft at
  `~/.cache/rocket-glm53-exl3-host/models/glm-5.3-flash-dflash2`, 5 dense
  layers, codebook candidate selector, fc [4096, 20480] aux-hidden combine);
  target k=2 at c8 with acceptance telemetry
- kv_b fp8 inside `mla_absorb_q` / `mla_expand_v`
- warm pair bench at c8 with full caches

**Reopen if.**

- The hub checkpoint changes revision or the NIM bundle returns with
  different tensor semantics.
- Greedy token identity breaks on any accepted family after an engine change.
